title: Local SEO audit: dementia care in Scottsdale

blocks.text: Build one dementia care page that tells families what a visit includes, what hours you can cover and how to check availability. Make overnight and weekend care easy to find if you offer them.

cards: Five service pages from four Scottsdale-area providers.
Two example queries place the website in the first ten results.
Overnight and weekend prompts name the agency three times. None links to its site.

blocks.text: What makes this the first move

Heritage makes minimum hours explicit. Wellby answers whether an awake overnight shift or one-off weekend is possible. In the fictional example, the agency has a general services page and leaves families to ask by phone. Give them enough detail to decide whether to call.
What to do first

rows: Check that Google can index the main care page; fix any confirmed blockers.
A page can’t compete if Google can’t index it.
Publish the dementia care page, then make respite hours and availability easy to find.
It answers the questions the general services page leaves open.
Align the Google Business Profile and retest after launch.
Families should see consistent services, hours and contact details.

blocks.text: Evidence key: competitor pages and observations are real. Sonoran Path Home Care, the ranks, AI results and site or listing examples are fictional. No private accounts were accessed. Nothing here measures a real agency’s ranking, traffic or leads.
What can a family decide before picking up the phone? Two Scottsdale-focused web searches surfaced these five pages, reviewed on November 27, 2026.

headers: What the page lets families decide
rows: Publishes a four-hour minimum visit and a 12-hour weekly minimum. Gives example weekly schedules and explains what the in-home assessment covers.
Links from its dementia page to separate respite, overnight and 24-hour care pages. Families can explore the coverage they need without knowing the service name first.
Names the areas served, explains how caregivers are matched and describes when non-medical home support may not be enough.
Answers questions about a one-off weekend and awake overnight coverage. Says most respite starts with a four-hour minimum.
Walks families through dates, routines, cost and family updates. Discusses one-time and recurring help without promising staff availability.

blocks.text: What stands out

Heritage explains minimum hours. Cypress connects dementia care to overnight and round-the-clock options. Seniors Helping Seniors describes caregiver matching and when home support may not be enough. On respite, Wellby answers schedule questions; Heritage explains what to bring to the first conversation.
This compares the linked pages, not care quality or the providers’ entire websites.

Where does the website show up, and where does the agency listing show up? Standard Google results and Google Maps answer different questions.

In this example, the website is top 10 for 2 of 12 searches and Maps is top 10 for 3 of 12. For the three dementia queries (R04–R06), Google web finds only the general Services page. The site is not seen for R09–R11: overnight or short-shift and weekend respite.

Illustrative snapshot: central Scottsdale, AZ; mobile; English. “Not seen” means not in the first 20 on that surface, not unindexed. In a live audit record date, device, location, depth, ranking URL and matched listing.

blocks.text: Excerpts and .example links are invented. A live check stores prompt, engine, date, setup, answer and exact links. Track “no AI answer” and failed runs separately from answers that omit the brand. AI results are not organic or Maps rankings.

Start with the questions families need answered before they call. Each idea below connects a real provider example to a gap in the simulated rankings or AI results. It does not predict a ranking lift.

rows: Can you help at home with dementia?
R04–R06 lead only to Services. Heritage and Seniors Helping Seniors explain routines, fit and next steps.
Create /services/dementia-care/. Explain visit tasks, how caregivers are matched, areas served and the first call.
Can you cover a night or weekend?
R09–R11 are outside the web top 20. A05–A08 produce no site links. Wellby explains awake shifts; Heritage explains handoff.
Create or expand /services/respite-care/. List actual shifts, minimums, notice and how to check availability.
What does it cost? Can I start small?
A13–A16 have 3/24 mentions and no site links. Heritage states visit and weekly minimums.
Add a cost and minimums section. Explain what affects a quote. Use only rates the agency approves.
A09–A12 have 6/24 mentions and one site link. Heritage and Seniors Helping Seniors outline how care starts.
Add a first-visit checklist. Link it from the dementia page and from Contact.

blocks.text: Example opening for the dementia care page
“Tell us which hours are hardest to cover and what your loved one needs during that time. We’ll explain what a caregiver can help with at home and check whether we can cover those hours.”
Suggested button: Ask about care hours. Confirm staffing, visit lengths and prices before publishing. Skip neighborhood pages that repeat the same information.
Fix confirmed blockers before evaluating a new page. The examples below are checks to run, not results from a real crawl or account.
Google Business Profile (the Maps listing)

rows: Confirm what the agency actually offers. Add respite if available, match staffed phone hours to the site and verify the main category, phone and website. Add holiday hours as needed.
Public checks: reviews and local listings
Check review recency and replies, recent photos, and consistent name, phone and URL in relevant directories. Look for real referral links instead of buying listings.
Confirm verification, service areas and address eligibility. Hide the address if customers don’t visit it. Record available profile calls and website clicks; don’t treat them as bookings.

blocks.text: Can Google find and use the page?

rows: Illustrative: 2 links to a retired URL
Update internal links. Redirect the old URL only when a relevant replacement exists. Recrawl and confirm the destination returns HTTP 200.
Illustrative: 1 care page points to Services as the preferred URL
Use Search Console to inspect index status and Google’s chosen URL. Check for unintended noindex or crawl blocks. Align the canonical URL, sitemap and internal links.
Check: hard to find from Services
Make the service page reachable on mobile through a crawlable link. Check the title, main heading, rendered copy and sitemap entry.
Check: slow page or broken inquiry path
Use real-user Core Web Vitals where available and a lab test to diagnose. Test the phone link and form on mobile. Check that any structured data matches visible content.

blocks.text: A crawlable page is not necessarily indexed. Google’s AI features use the usual search fundamentals; they do not require special AI schema.

pages.title: Recommended Actions

rows: Check index status and repair broken paths or the wrong preferred URL if found. Save a 12-query Google and Maps baseline, a 16-prompt AI baseline, and current site performance.
URL Inspection and a recrawl show the intended page and working path.
Publish the dementia page with visit tasks, minimums and first-call steps. Link to it from Services.
Check indexing, then impressions and clicks for R04–R06 and answer coverage for A01–A04.
Update respite with confirmed overnight or weekend coverage, notice and minimums. Add cost and first-visit answers.
Retest R09–R11 and A05–A08; track mentions and links separately. Track calls and forms that start on those pages.
Confirm Business Profile details, service area and website link.
Compare available Business Profile interactions and matched-location Maps checks.

blocks.text: Check again after 30 days

Once the pages are indexed, compare equal time periods. Keep search setup, AI prompts, engines and tracked peers fixed. Lead with Search Console impressions and clicks, not position alone. Separate search exposure, AI links and completed inquiries. If counts are low, report direction without claiming the changes caused it.
